info.name: Gazebo - Purchasing Deliveries
info.description:
Goods-in **truck visits** against one purchase order.

**Table:** `po_purchase_order_delivery` (session QC) + `po_purchase_order_delivery_line` (this visit’s line QC / qty).

PO line totals (`qty_ordered` / `qty_received` / `qty_balance`) stay on the order. Each visit has its own header QC, reject flag, photos, and lots. A header-rejected visit does **not** consume qty; the supplier’s next truck is `POST /deliveries/`. When every line `qty_balance` is 0 the PO auto-closes (`received`) and no further deliveries are accepted.

**Vars:** `{{base_url}}`, `{{po_id}}`, `{{delivery_id}}`, `{{line_id}}`, `{{location_id}}`.

request.description:
### List deliveries

`GET /purchasing/pos/:po_id/deliveries/`

Lists every truck visit on this PO (rejected stays on file; later visits are extra rows). Use this after a reject to confirm D1 is `rejected` before opening D2.

**Path parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `po_id` | yes | Purchase order PK |

**Query parameters**

None.

**Request body**

**None**.

**Response body**

`message`: `Deliveries fetched successfully.` `data.count` plus `data.results[]` with `id`, `status` (`open` \| `rejected` \| `received`), `delivery_at`, `delivery_trace_number`, `reject_delivery`, `checked_at`.

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Success |
| 404 | PO not found |

### Start delivery

`POST /purchasing/pos/:po_id/deliveries/`

Opens a new goods-in visit. Example: Mitaka salt 5 bags — after truck 1 is rejected, POST again for truck 2 (3 bags) then truck 3 (2 bags). Blocked when an `open` delivery exists, when the PO is not `ordered`/`partial`, or when `qty_balance` is 0 on every line (PO already `received`).

**Path parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `po_id` | yes | Purchase order PK |

**Query parameters**

None.

**Request body**

**None** (empty JSON object is fine).

**Response body**

`201` `Delivery created successfully.` `data.id`, `data.status=open`, `data.purchase_order_id`.

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 201 | Created |
| 400 | Already an open delivery, PO fully received, or status not ordered/partial |
| 404 | PO not found |

### Get delivery goods-in form

`GET /purchasing/pos/:po_id/deliveries/:delivery_id/`

Resolved GFF001F checklist **for this visit** (header items, line items, saved answers, attachments on this delivery only). PO qty totals are included so the warehouse sees remaining balance.

**Path parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `po_id` | yes | Purchase order PK |
| `delivery_id` | yes | Delivery PK on this PO |

**Query parameters**

None.

**Request body**

**None**.

**Response body**

`message`: `Goods inward form resolved successfully.` Same shape as `GET …/goods-in-form/` plus `delivery_id` and `delivery_status`. `reject_delivery` and `saved_header_answers` come from this visit.

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Success |
| 404 | PO or delivery not found |

### Header QC

`POST /purchasing/pos/:po_id/deliveries/:delivery_id/qc/header/`

Vehicle / packaging / reject checks for **this truck**. Required answers depend on the goods-in header template (food vs packaging vs other). Set `reject_delivery.value=true` (or fail a critical check) to turn the truck away: delivery becomes `rejected`, PO qty is unchanged, then `POST /deliveries/` for the replacement.

**Path parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `po_id` | yes | Purchase order PK |
| `delivery_id` | yes | Open delivery PK |

**Query parameters**

None.

**Request body**

| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `checked_by_user_id` | yes | Warehouse user PK |
| `delivery_date` | no | Defaults to expected/today; Julian trace unless override |
| `trace_override` | no | Requires `override_reason` |
| `answers` | yes | Object keyed by check code (`value`, optional `comment`) |
| `qc_tl_checked_by_user_id` | no | Dual sign-off |
| `remarks` | no | Stored on PO when rejecting |

**Response body**

Goods-in form for this delivery. `reject_delivery` true and `delivery_status=rejected` when the truck is turned away.

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Saved |
| 400 | Missing answers, delivery not open, PO not ordered/partial |
| 404 | PO or delivery not found |

### Draft header QC

`PATCH /purchasing/pos/:po_id/deliveries/:delivery_id/qc/header/`

Save one or more header answers without completing QC. The operator can leave and resume: GET form returns `saved_header_answers` and `qc_draft=true`. `checked_at` stays empty until POST submit with every required answer.

**Path parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `po_id` | yes | Purchase order PK |
| `delivery_id` | yes | Open delivery PK |

**Query parameters**

None.

**Request body**

| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `checked_by_user_id` | yes | Warehouse user PK |
| `answers` | yes | Partial object keyed by check code |
| `delivery_date` | no | Stored on the delivery if sent |

**Response body**

`message`: `Header QC draft saved successfully.` Goods-in form. `qc_draft` true, `checked_at` null.

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Draft saved |
| 400 | Unknown code, header already submitted, delivery not open |
| 404 | PO or delivery not found |

### Line QC

`POST /purchasing/pos/:po_id/deliveries/:delivery_id/lines/:line_id/qc/`

Product checks for this visit (use-by, temp, spec). Must follow passed header QC on the **same** open delivery. A previous visit’s line QC is not reused — truck 3 of a split drop needs its own lots / UBD.

**Path parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `po_id` | yes | Purchase order PK |
| `delivery_id` | yes | Open delivery PK |
| `line_id` | yes | PO line PK |

**Query parameters**

None.

**Request body**

| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `checked_by_user_id` | no | Actor for history |
| `answers` | yes | Object keyed by line check code |
| `trace_override` / `trace_number` | no | Lot trace; else delivery Julian |

**Response body**

Goods-in form. Line `line_check_ok` on this delivery line.

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Saved |
| 400 | Header not done, delivery rejected, missing answers |
| 404 | PO, delivery, or line not found |

### Draft line QC

`PATCH /purchasing/pos/:po_id/deliveries/:delivery_id/lines/:line_id/qc/`

Save one or more line answers without setting `line_check_ok`. Resume via GET form (`lines[].qc_draft`). POST submit still requires every shown required check.

**Path parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `po_id` | yes | Purchase order PK |
| `delivery_id` | yes | Open delivery PK |
| `line_id` | yes | PO line PK |

**Query parameters**

None.

**Request body**

| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `checked_by_user_id` | yes | Warehouse user PK |
| `answers` | yes | Partial object keyed by line check code |

**Response body**

`message`: `Line QC draft saved successfully.` Goods-in form. Line `qc_draft` true, `line_check_ok` false.

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Draft saved |
| 400 | Unknown code, line already submitted, delivery rejected |
| 404 | PO, delivery, or line not found |

### Receive against a delivery

`POST /purchasing/pos/:po_id/deliveries/:delivery_id/receive/`

Stocks this visit and adds qty onto the PO line. Example: 5 bags ordered, this truck 3 bags with `short_delivery` — PO goes `partial`, balance 2, delivery `received`. The last 2 bags are a **new** delivery. Over-receive vs remaining balance is 400. Header reject on this delivery is 400 (qty stays 0).

Warehouse write gate: `goods_in`.

**Path parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `po_id` | yes | Purchase order PK |
| `delivery_id` | yes | Open delivery that passed header QC |

**Query parameters**

None.

**Request body**

| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `location_id` | yes (if no ship-to) | Stock location |
| `lines` | yes | Non-empty array |
| `lines[].line_id` | yes | PO line |
| `lines[].quantity` | yes | Purchase qty this drop |
| `lines[].idempotency_key` | yes | Replay-safe stock key |
| `lines[].shortfall_reason` | yes if qty < balance | e.g. `short_delivery` |
| `quarantine` | no | Require quarantine location |

**Response body**

`201` `Goods received successfully.` Goods-in form plus `receive_results[]` (`qty_received`, `qty_balance`, stock entries). Delivery `status=received`. If all lines satisfied, PO `status=received`.

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 201 | Received |
| 400 | Rejected/open QC missing, over qty, no balance, line QC fail |
| 404 | PO, delivery, or line not found |

### List delivery attachments

`GET /purchasing/pos/:po_id/deliveries/:delivery_id/attachments/`

Photos / COA / delivery note for **this visit** (a rejected truck’s photos stay here, not on the replacement delivery).

**Path parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `po_id` | yes | Purchase order PK |
| `delivery_id` | yes | Delivery PK |

**Query parameters**

None.

**Request body**

**None**.

**Response body**

`Attachments fetched successfully.` `data.count` / `data.results[]` with `id`, `kind`, `url`, `delivery_id`.

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Success |
| 404 | PO or delivery not found |

### Upload delivery attachment

`POST /purchasing/pos/:po_id/deliveries/:delivery_id/attachments/`

Stores a file on this visit (S3 key under `Goods-in/`). Rejected-truck evidence stays on the rejected delivery row.

**Path parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `po_id` | yes | Purchase order PK |
| `delivery_id` | yes | Delivery PK |

**Query parameters**

None.

**Request body**

Multipart.

| Field | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `file` | yes | JPEG, PNG, WebP, or PDF, max 5 MB |
| `kind` | no | `photo` (default), `coa`, `delivery_note`, `other` |
| `line_id` | no | Tie to a PO line |
| `uploaded_by_user_id` | no | Else JWT actor |

**Response body**

`201` `Attachment uploaded successfully.` Attachment dict including `delivery_id` and presigned `url`.

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 201 | Uploaded |
| 400 | Missing/invalid file or kind |
| 404 | PO or delivery not found |

### Print delivery PDF

`GET /purchasing/pos/:po_id/deliveries/:delivery_id/print/`

GFF001F-style PDF for **this visit’s** saved header/line answers (not the whole PO history).

**Path parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `po_id` | yes | Purchase order PK |
| `delivery_id` | yes | Delivery PK |

**Query parameters**

None.

**Request body**

**None**.

**Response body**

`application/pdf` (`goods-in-{po_id}-{delivery_id}.pdf`).

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | PDF |
| 404 | PO or delivery not found |

### PO timeline

`GET /purchasing/pos/:po_id/timeline/`

Same event shape as product (`GET /product/:id/timeline/`) and recipe audit: newest first. Each event has `before_json` / `after_json` / `changed_fields` plus an `actor` object recorded at write time (JWT sub, name, email, workstation, IP).

Composes PO create/update, goods-in QC (`accept` / `reject` / `non_conformance` / `note`), stock receive (`goods_in`), label print/scan, and stock post.

**Path parameters**

| Param | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `po_id` | yes | Purchase order PK |

**Query parameters**

None.

**Request body**

**None**.

**Response body**

`message`: `Purchase order timeline fetched successfully.`

`data` is an array of events:

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `at` | ISO datetime |
| `entity` | `purchase_order`, `delivery`, `po_line`, or `stock_entry` |
| `action` | `create`, `update`, `accept`, `reject`, `non_conformance`, `note`, `goods_in`, `label_printed`, `label_scanned`, `stock_posted` |
| `actor` | `{ user_id, sub, name, email, source_workstation, source_workstation_ip }` |
| `before_json` | State before this step |
| `after_json` | State after this step |
| `changed_fields` | Keys that differ |

**Status codes**

| Code | When |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | Success |
| 404 | PO not found |
